Subject: Redwood pilot discovery — VPC / Dedicated feasibility (recap)

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps from my side. High-level notes from our discovery call:

- Business need: run customer-facing recommendation & summarization features on sensitive transaction data (PCI-adjacent), want isolation and strict data controls.
- Throughput / latency targets: ~80–120 qps peak, 50ms tail goal for short prompts, mostly generation with some embedding lookups.
- Data & compliance: will need SOC 2 evidence + VPC/private control plane, possibility of on-prem later for EU customers.
- Ops constraints: small infra team (1x infra eng + 1x platform lead) — prefer predictable operational model.

Where Redwood can help (next actions I propose):
1) Share our Dedicated / Private overview (attached) so you can validate fit and bring to infra/legal.
2) Draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines + procurement milestones.
3) Provide a ballpark committed capacity estimate for the QPS above and a compliance snapshot.
4) Schedule a 30-min technical follow-up with Aditya (solutions) + Dev (infra) to go over network requirements and pilot cutover steps.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-overview.pdf (1 page executive + 2 page tech appendix).

Question for you: is securing a reserved Dedicated slot for a mid-May pilot still realistic on your side? If priority has shifted we’ll adjust the MAP — otherwise I’ll send a draft by Friday.

Best,
Mina Haddad
